steps.name: download
steps.description: Raw capture folders downloaded into T0_raw (sensor dirs e.g. nHP-809, OS1-128, ILX-LR1, SBG, gnss, logs).

steps.name: bundle
steps.description: Raw data bundled into exactly one .graw in T0_raw (two .graw bundles is a blocked state needing curation).

steps.name: process
steps.description: GRYFN processing produces the .gpro products and, when ELM panels and the vnir payload were flown, a valid ELM coefficients file inside the .graw (a ~1 KB elm_coefficients.json means processing failed).

steps.name: qc_testing
steps.description: QC testing artefacts all produced: vector data (GeoJSON per the QA Process SOP; GOBI has only the VNIR orthomosaic) and extracted spectral tables in T1_proc/QC_data. Panel polygons follow QC_{ELM|VAL}[_{TargetIdentifier}]_Panels naming; spectra tables follow the QA00 v2.2 QC_{ELM|VAL}[_{id}]_spectra_VNIR naming (legacy VNIR[0-9]_*Panel* tables still count).

steps.name: qc_report
steps.description: All four DS02 contract QC reports generated AND not failing (list = AND; per-rule requires gates skip inapplicable payloads). QC00: legacy loose QC_GCP*distances*_report.json (every status.result == 'pass'; the glob keeps QC_GCP_groundtruth_* from counting as QC evidence) OR the contract QC00_GCPCheck detail (status pass|warn) — legacy alternative retires once the store is migrated. QC01 grades real verdicts (pass|warn counts, fail blocks; gated on vnir because QC01 skips gpros with no hyperspec flight lines; a fail whose gating checks are all covered by closed 'accepted' qc_findings is waived by PS00). QC02/QC03 are presence-tracked: their checks are advisory (status not_evaluated by design), so any status except fail counts — this makes the run-the-new-QC migration work visible on the dashboard without pretending advisory scripts have verdicts. A report that exists but fails is failed_check, not done.

steps.name: raw_cleanup
steps.description: Loose download folders removed from T0_raw; only the .graw (+ Vault + RGB) remains (DM00_GPTRawCleanup).
